The '''Cloak of the Sith''' was a dense dust cloud in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] which concealed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="DBBaobab" />

==History==
The region was hard to navigate, making Roon somewhat inaccessible; only two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] were known to reach the planet. One, the [[Manda-Roon Merchant Route]] discovered by [[Mungo Baobab]], was a challenge for seasoned astrogators and was demarcated by a series of "[[lightstation]]" [[Navigation buoy/Legends|nav beacons]]. The more secret [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] was a "back door" through the Cloak used by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

During the [[New Sith Wars]], it was the core of the [[New Sith]] Empire ruled by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]. Following the final death of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], it was rumored that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] continued to exist and rebuild within the Cloak.

A female [[Vongerella|Force-sensitive Yuuzhan Vong]] operated within the Cloak of the Sith.
